import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx', data_only=False)

for row in range(2,6):
    scores=[]
    for col in range(2,15):  # B to N

        if isinstance(v,(int,float)):
            scores.append(v)
    last4 = scores[-4:]
    avg = sum(last4)/len(last4) if last4 else None
    ws.cell(row=row, column=17).value = avg
    print(row, scores, last4, avg)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
